ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: In circle $ \odot O$, $ AB$ is a diameter, and point $C$ is a point on the circle. Fold the minor arc along chord $ AC$ to intersect $ AB$ at point $D$. Connect $ CD$. As shown in Figure 2, if point $D$ and the center $O$ do not coincide, and $ \angle BAC=20^\circ$, find the degree measure of $ \angle DCA$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Let the symmetrical point of point D with respect to chord $AC$ be F, and connect $AF$ and $CB$, \\
According to the problem, we get $\angle BAC=\angle FAC=20^\circ$, $CD=CF$, \\
Hence, $CB=CF=CD$, \\
Thus, $\angle B=\angle CDB$; \\
Since $AB$ is the diameter, \\
Therefore, $\angle ACB=90^\circ, \angle B=\angle CDB=70^\circ$, \\
Therefore, $\angle DCA=\angle CDB-\angle BAC=70^\circ-20^\circ=\boxed{50^\circ}$.

method.method_draft: Use an analytic reflected-circle model. From the image read the same incidence pattern: D is the noncentral intersection of the folded arc with diameter AB, and C is on the circle. From the text take AB as a diameter and ∠BAC=20°. Set coordinates with A=(0,0), B=(1,0), so O=(1/2,0), and let α=20°. Since C lies on the circle with diameter AB and on the ray making angle α with AB, C=(cos^2α, sinα cosα). Folding across AC reflects the original circle to a congruent circle whose center is the reflection of O across the line AC. The reflection of O=(1/2,0) across the line through A at angle α is O'=(1/2 cos2α, 1/2 sin2α), with radius 1/2. Intersect this reflected circle with AB, i.e. y=0: (x−(1/2)cos2α)^2+((1/2)sin2α)^2=(1/2)^2, giving x=0 or x=cos2α. The relevant point is D=(cos2α,0). Then vector CA has direction angle 180°+α, while vector CD=(cos2α−cos^2α,−sinα cosα)=(-sin^2α,−sinα cosα), whose direction is 270°−α. Thus ∠DCA=(270°−α)−(180°+α)=90°−2α=50° for α=20°.

solver_metadata.cot_raw: 图像描述：附件图中有图1和图2。图2显示一个圆，A在左下方圆周上，B在右上方圆周上，AB经过圆心O，是直径；C在右侧圆周上，AC为一条弦；折叠后的弧从A到C并经过AB上的点D，图中D位于AB上且不与O重合，同时连有线段CD。推理：按指定解析反射圆模型建立坐标。设A=(0,0)，B=(1,0)，则O=(1/2,0)，AB为x轴，令α=∠BAC=20°。因为C在以AB为直径的圆上，且C在从A出发与AB成α角的射线上，所以C=(cos²α, sinα cosα)。沿弦AC折叠等价于把原圆关于直线AC反射，原圆圆心O反射到O'。直线AC过A且方向角为α，故O=(1/2,0)关于该直线的反射点为O'=(1/2 cos2α, 1/2 sin2α)，反射圆半径仍为1/2。D在AB上，所以令y=0并代入反射圆方程：(x−(1/2)cos2α)²+((1/2)sin2α)²=(1/2)²，解得x=0或x=cos2α。x=0对应A，故图2中的非A交点D=(cos2α,0)。从C看，向量CA=(−cos²α,−sinα cosα)，其方向角为180°+α；向量CD=(cos2α−cos²α,−sinα cosα)=(−sin²α,−sinα cosα)，其方向角为270°−α。因此∠DCA=(270°−α)−(180°+α)=90°−2α。代入α=20°，得∠DCA=90°−40°=50°。结论：∠DCA=50°。

raw_record.original_question: In circle $\odot O$, $AB$ is a diameter, and $C$ is a point on the circle. Fold the minor arc along chord $AC$ so that it intersects $AB$ at point $D$, and connect $CD$. As shown in Figure 2, if point $D$ and the center $O$ do not coincide, and $\angle BAC = 20^\circ$, find the measure of $\angle DCA$.
raw_record.answer: Let the symmetrical point of point $D$ with respect to chord $AC$ be $F$, and connect $AF$ and $CB$. According to the problem, we get $\angle BAC = \angle FAC = 20^\circ$ and $CD = CF$. Hence, $CB = CF = CD$. Thus, $\angle B = \angle CDB$. Since $AB$ is the diameter, $\angle ACB = 90^\circ$, so $\angle B = \angle CDB = 70^\circ$. Therefore, $\angle DCA = \angle CDB - \angle BAC = 70^\circ - 20^\circ = \boxed{50^\circ}$.
raw_record.final_cot:
Image description: There are two circular diagrams, Figure 1 and Figure 2, in the figure. In Figure 2, there is an oblique diameter AB inside the circle, and the center O of the circle is on AB; A is on the lower-left circumference, B is on the upper-right circumference, and C is on the right-side circumference; the folded arc passes through A, D, and C, where D is located on the diameter AB and does not coincide with O, and CD is drawn.

Reasoning: According to the folding relationship, take F as the symmetric point of D with respect to the crease AC, then F is on the original arc. Because A and C are on the crease AC, A and C do not move during reflection, so CD = CF; at the same time, ray AF is the reflection of ray AD with respect to AC. From Figure 2 and the meaning of the problem, D is on AB, so AD and AB are collinear, thus ∠DAC = ∠BAC = 20°. After reflection, we obtain ∠FAC = 20°. In the original circle, ∠FAC and ∠BAC are equal inscribed angles, so the chords FC and BC that they subtend are equal, that is, FC = BC. Also CD = CF, therefore CD = CF = CB. Thus in triangle BCD, CB = CD, so the base angles ∠CBD = ∠CDB. Since AB is a diameter, ∠ACB = 90°, and also ∠BAC = 20°, so ∠ABC = 70°. D is on AB, so ∠CBD = ∠ABC = 70°, hence ∠CDB = 70°. Finally, the angle between CD and AB is 70°, and the angle between AC and AB is 20°, so ∠DCA = 70° - 20° = 50°.
